entries.clue: Handled leather cord that cracks like a shot as the cats perform
Brother who scattered white pebbles to find the way home from the wood
Weser town that cheated its pied piper and lost its children to his tune
Reflective piece evoking the hush of night
Vain ruler parading in finery only the clever could supposedly see
Shaped sliver of plastic used for strumming
Longest note in ordinary use, worth a whole bar of common time
Strapped-on poles that turn a strolling performer into a giant
Vessel that would not stop cooking sweet porridge, in a German tale
Allegro or largo, say, considered as speed rather than mood
Silent whiteface act, all gesture and never a spoken word
Maned roarer the tamer holds off with a raised chair
Unmarried woman; the word first meant one who works at the wheel
